title: Chapter 210 Killing The High-Level General Black Dragon King
content:
Chapter 210 Killing The High-Level General Black Dragon King

A drop of sweat squeezed out of his dry face, which must have meant that he was in great pain.

"It's been a thousand years!"

Wang Shuo was shocked. Could it be that the Black Dragon King had been suffering this kind of pain for the past thousand years?

"Blood debts must be paid with blood."

...

"The winner is the king and the loser is the bandit..."

The Black Dragon King murmured to himself, sometimes in a voice as loud as a mosquito or a mad roar.

Wang Shuo felt that the Black Dragon King had gone crazy from being tortured!

"Young man, hurry up, kill me!" The Black Dragon King said hurriedly, with a trace of longing in his eyes.

Wang Shuo didn't know what to do for a while.

"Maybe I can save you!" Wang Shuo suddenly felt a trace of compassion.

No matter how big the fault was, after enduring a thousand years of inhuman torture, it should be possible to atone for the sin!

And the country that the Black Dragon King built with his own hands has been reduced to ashes!

"It's useless."

The Black Dragon King seemed to have regained a trace of clarity. After he finished speaking, he sighed dejectedly and fell silent again.

Wang Shuo did not act rashly and maintained the necessary vigilance.

"Agui, do you know the past of this Black Dragon King?"

"I'm ashamed to say that I only know that Black Dragon City was destroyed by Queen Anna of the Truni Empire, and I don't know anything else."

"Useless thing."

Wang Shuo looked at the Black Dragon King patiently, fighting against the death.

After a long time, when Wang Shuo was a little bored, the Black Dragon King finally had no death above his neck.

He looked up at Wang Shuo, his dry face trembling, and slowly said: "Young man, are you interested in listening to my story?"

Wang Shuo was so excited that he almost cried, he was really interested.

There was no way, in order to complete the task, he had to want to listen.

"I was originally an earl of the North Sea Empire, and Black Dragon City was my fiefdom. That year, the old emperor of the empire passed away, and the new emperor was young and unable to control the huge empire. The princes of various places were ready to move, and external forces were eyeing them covetously."

"The sudden evil cult organization Holy Fire Sect took the opportunity to stir up trouble, but the princes of the empire turned a blind eye. All places used the excuse of suppressing the Holy Fire Sect. The earth was full of smoke and the empire was in turmoil."

"Until someone proclaimed himself queen, I also killed the supervisor and proclaimed myself the Black Dragon King. Unexpectedly, this planted the seeds of genocide for myself."

...

Wang Shuo felt mixed emotions when he heard the dusty past told by the Black Dragon King.

His words were full of regret, unwillingness, and repentance.

Wang Shuo couldn't help but be moved.

[Listening to the Black Dragon King's story, the side quest is 80% complete. 】

Wang Shuo was shocked. The side quest has not been completed yet?

Is there any report that has been forgotten?

At this time, the Black Dragon King slowly said: "Young man, kill me, my soul has been tortured for thousands of years, and it has been miserable!"

However, there was a faint trace of death in his lowered eyes, looming.

Wang Shuo sighed and said lightly: "Okay!"

Hearing Wang Shuo's voice of agreement.

The Black Dragon King relaxed as if he had been relieved, but the smile on his dry face was a little weird, a bit like a conspiracy.

Wang Shuo didn't think much about it, but just felt that the other party's knowing smile was a bit creepy.

Wang Shuo didn't walk over, but stood in place and let Li Jianguo take out the bronze crossbow cart.

After loading the bronze spear, of course, he had to do it himself.

"Swoosh"

The bronze spear pierced the Black Dragon King's head, and it was immediately like a smashed watermelon, breaking into pieces.

There was no scene of blood splattering, only withered skull fragments scattered all over the ground.

Killed with one strike, which surprised Wang Shuo.
